title: kritika
description: kritika's health, intake, reviews, model spend, runner Jobs and database pools, from the metrics the chart's ServiceMonitor scrapes.

panels.title: Leaders
panels.description: Replicas holding the leader lock. Exactly one is healthy; none means nothing migrates, applies configuration, polls or rescues jobs.

panels.title: Configuration
panels.description: Whether the leader's latest attempt to apply the configuration file was refused. The last applied configuration stays live meanwhile.

panels.title: Drifted replicas
panels.description: Replicas whose configuration file differs from the one the leader applied. Expected for the minute or two a rollout takes.

panels.title: Reviews
panels.description: Reviews that reached a terminal status over the dashboard's time range.

panels.title: Model cost
panels.description: Provider-reported spend over the dashboard's time range.

panels.title: Leader lock by replica
panels.description: 1 while a replica holds the leader lock. Two at once for longer than a leader retry interval means the replicas are not on one database.

panels.title: Jobs rescued from dead replicas
panels.description: Jobs a replica died working, handed back to the queue by the leader: retryable, discarded (no attempts left) or cancelled.

panels.title: Backstop polls
panels.description: The leader's polls of each app's open pull requests, its backstop for missed webhooks, and the pull requests they handed to ingest.

panels.title: Forge rate limits
panels.description: Responses GitHub refused for a rate limit: waited (the request waited the limit out and was sent again) or refused.

panels.title: Reviews by status
panels.description: Reviews reaching a terminal status, and reviews put back on the queue because every model slot was held.

panels.title: Review duration
panels.description: Wall time of a review job from pickup to terminal status.

panels.title: Follow-ups by outcome
panels.description: Mentions handled: answered, limited, ignored, failed.

panels.title: Wait for a model slot

targets.expr: histogram_quantile(0.5, sum by (model, le) (rate(kritika_lease_wait_seconds_bucket{namespace=~"$namespace", job=~"$job", account=~"$account", model=~"$model"}[$__rate_interval])))
histogram_quantile(0.95, sum by (model, le) (rate(kritika_lease_wait_seconds_bucket{namespace=~"$namespace", job=~"$job", account=~"$account", model=~"$model"}[$__rate_interval])))

panels.description: Time a review spent waiting for a model concurrency slot.

panels.title: Model calls

targets.expr: sum by (model, outcome) (rate(kritika_model_calls_total{namespace=~"$namespace", job=~"$job", account=~"$account", model=~"$model"}[$__rate_interval]))

panels.description: By the model that answered, so a provider's fallback shows under its own name.

panels.title: Tokens by direction
panels.description: Tokens per second: input, cached (the part of input the provider served from its prompt cache) and output.

panels.title: Cost per hour by model
panels.description: Provider-reported cost, as an hourly rate.

panels.title: Cost over the time range by account
Runner Jobs
panels.description: Runner Jobs finished: success, failed, deadline.

panels.title: Gateway egress
panels.description: Requests runner pods made through the gateway: connect or http; allowed, refused, error.

panels.title: Context chunks by stage
panels.description: Context a review's prompt was given: overlay, definition, caller, similar (the index).

panels.title: Pool connections
panels.description: Connections the app and owner pools hold by state, and each pool's ceiling. A pool at its ceiling queues jobs and requests.

panels.title: Pool acquire wait

targets.expr: sum by (pool) (rate(kritika_db_pool_acquire_seconds_total{namespace=~"$namespace", job=~"$job"}[$__rate_interval])) / sum by (pool) (rate(kritika_db_pool_acquires_total{namespace=~"$namespace", job=~"$job"}[$__rate_interval]))

panels.description: Mean time a connection acquire waited for the pool to hand one over.
